fixed.summary: Generated recipe sheets again retain their authored resolution, ramps, dithering, alpha and outlines under a selected look. The texture conformance pass now honors their internal opt-out after the TypeScript import cutover; re-cook affected effects without adding author overrides.

breaking.change: Particle-layer spawn area uses separate areaX and areaY fields; the old area tuple is rejected.
breaking.fix: Replace area: [x, y] with areaX: x, areaY: y inside each recipe particle layer. These are vfx2d recipe fields, not file.particles emitter fields.

breaking.change: Checked recipes reject the formerly ignored note field at the recipe root and inside layers.
breaking.fix: Remove note properties from recipe data and put the same text in TypeScript comments beside the recipe or layer.
